name: Atla
tagline: Evaluation layer that finds and fixes AI agent failures.
description: Atla is an evaluation platform that automatically discovers, clusters, and ranks failures in AI agents, then suggests fixes. Rather than prompting a general model to grade outputs, it runs on Atla's own Selene LLM-judge models, purpose-trained to score and critique generative-AI responses. It offers Python and TypeScript SDKs and integrates with stacks like OpenAI and LangChain.

modelSupport.notes: Evaluations run on Atla's purpose-built Selene judge models.

edge: Built around its own Selene LLM-judge models instead of prompting a general model, then clusters and ranks agent failures so you fix the most impactful first.
